title: Collider Interpretation
description: Structured declaration of a workstream agent's interpretation of a cross-boundary concept.

generation_mode.description: How this interpretation was produced. LIVE_BOB = real Bob session. PRESEEDED = authored fixture. Must never be LIVE_BOB unless a real session produced it.

concept.description: The cross-boundary concept this claim is about (e.g. customer_identity, field_name, money_representation, notification_contact).

value.description: The value the workstream chose for this concept.

epistemic_state.description: OBSERVED requires a cited source passage. INFERRED = plausible but not explicitly specified. UNKNOWN = no basis determined.

evidence_refs.description: Source document citations supporting this interpretation. Empty only when epistemic_state is UNKNOWN.

evidence_relation.description: EXPLICIT = source names this exact value. INFERRED = source is consistent but does not name it. UNAVAILABLE = no source found. CONFLICTING = sources disagree.

consumed_by.description: Workstream IDs whose implementation genuinely depends on this value. Used by impact router. Do not include workstreams that do not consume this concept.

artifact_refs.description: File/function references in this workstream's implementation where this decision is embodied.

not.description: Confidence must not be used as a substitute for evidence. Do not add a confidence field.
